headline: Aruna Oswal discloses substantial acquisition under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Aruna Oswal has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, triggering mandatory reporting under the SEBI Takeover Regulations on crossing a threshold in Oswal Greentech Limited shares.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure signals a threshold-crossing event (likely 5% slab under the Takeover Code); review whether further public announcement or open offer obligations are triggered under Regulations 3–5.
detail: The filing discloses a substantial acquisition of shares in Oswal Greentech Limited by Aruna Oswal under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This mandatory disclosure regime requires disclosure within 4 working days of acquisition and triggers gating thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90%) that may require public announcement or open offer. The disclosure was filed with NSE on 22 June 2026.
